How Does SCRIPE Enforce Enterprise Security Assurance & Platform Hardening Across All 19 Modules?

Long image

A

Answer

SCRIPE enforces 5-layer zero-trust defense across 19 backend modules, Next.js 16, and the CLI/CI toolchain. All 48 JSENTINEL findings, 26 net-new platform threats, and 10 adversarial review catches are closed and verified by 391 automated security tests.

  1. JSENTINEL 48/48 Reconciled: 13 confirmed live-drift findings closed (F02, F10, F11, F12-F17, F18, F28-F30), 31 bundle AST false positives disproved, and 4 managed-edge items bounded.
  2. 26 Net-New Threats & 10 Review Catches Closed: 3 Critical (TH-API-01 Paymob/PayPal webhook auth, TH-TEN-01 DSR ownership, TH-TEN-02 _scripe-verify DNS TXT), 15 High, and 8 Medium threats closed with 10 catches (R-01 to R-10).
  3. 5-Layer Defense & Nonce CSP: Per-request 128-bit x-nonce CSP, /studio-preview and /dashboard-preview frame isolation, 6-pass CSS/SVG sanitization, postMessage origin-plus-source guard, and DNS-pinned SSRF handlers protect all boundaries.
  4. 4-Layer Proof & Cutover Boundary: 318 xUnit, 65 Vitest, 8 live Chromium E2E journeys, and 100/100 security arch-check rules (BE-040..042, FE-035..036) gate code release and external production cutover.

Applies toSCRIPE-Backend (9953d551e) + SCRIPE-Frontend (d8ec386ad) + SCRIPE-CLI (268f169) + Root (d1c5fdb)

How Do the 5 Defense Layers, Nonce CSP, Tenant Isolation & DNS-Pinned SSRF Connect?

Diagram structure
  • Next.js Nonce Proxy edge_csp
  • Sanitizer & sw.js v3 client_store
  • Kestrel & FallbackPolicy api_ingress
  • 19-Mod Tenant & DSR Guard tenant_fls
  • DNS-Pin SSRF & HMAC ssrf_crypto
  • CLI Arch-Check & 0-CVE ci_audit
  • edge_csp → client_store · x-nonce + Origin
  • edge_csp → api_ingress · HTTPS + CSRF
  • api_ingress → tenant_fls · 4x9 PBAC + FLS
  • tenant_fls → ssrf_crypto · Outbox + FixedTime
  • ci_audit → api_ingress · BE/FE Rules + RE2

Click any highlighted node below to inspect how Next.js per-request nonce CSP, client storage guards, Kestrel ingress policies, 19-module tenant/DSR/FLS guards, DNS-pinned SSRF handlers, and CI supply-chain gates interlock.

  1. Per-Request Nonce CSP & Preview Framing ↗

    src/proxy.ts and security-headers.ts mint a 128-bit cryptographic x-nonce per request (ed2a07b3e) and allow SAMEORIGIN / frame-ancestors 'self' strictly on /studio-preview and /dashboard-preview (next.config.ts:14 (?:/|$) lookahead 84be82539; DENY elsewhere).

  2. Sanitization, postMessage & sw.js v3 ↗

    6-pass sanitize-css.ts unescapes CSS L3 backslashes, strips control chars, and validates url(...) via sanitizeCssAssetUrl (84be82539), postmessage-security.ts verifies origin+source+schema (c036eb63e), /sw.js (scripe-v3-static-only) excludes "/", /api/*, and ?_rsc= (c7f4a2d3e), and session-cleanup-registry.ts purges storage (4595de933).

  3. Kestrel Ingress, FallbackPolicy & no-store ↗

    Fail-closed FallbackPolicy (TH-API-02, 1c01a2843) protects all 198 controllers, Layer 2.5 CSRF normalizes trailing slashes (1b8461544), CacheHeadersMiddleware enforces Cache-Control: no-store on GET/POST and /plugin-api/* (0085f65df), and Track 2 proxy hardening sets ForwardLimit = 2.

  4. 19-Module Tenant, DSR, FLS & Custom Domain ↗

    IDsrSubjectOwnershipVerifier blocks cross-tenant and protected-admin DSR requests (TH-TEN-01, b446a5575), DnsVerificationService (AddTenantDomainCommandHandler / VerifyTenantDomainCommandHandler) requires _scripe-verify DNS TXT and RFC 1123 FQDN (TH-TEN-02, 9fffee765), and EndpointResourceResolver.ResolveAll, TenantMembershipContextResolver, and IOperationalScopeAccessResolver enforce FLS and scope ceilings (d36731937, 51480e2a7).

  5. DNS-Pinned SSRF, Webhooks & Plugin JWTs ↗

    SsrfSafeHttpClientHandlerFactory and PrivateNetworkIpPolicy pin validated public IPs at connect time with AllowAutoRedirect = false (31fbcc376, 88d921d3c), PaymobPaymentGateway and PayPal remove Flow A tenant overrides and use CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals (TH-API-01, 8567de9c3), and PluginTokenService issues short-lived HS256 JWTs (jti/iat/scripe_iat_ms, "plugin_token"="true") confined to /plugin-api/* via PluginTokenValidationGuard (31fbcc376, 88d921d3c).

  6. Static Security Rules, Fail-Closed Audit & RE2 ↗

    BE-040..042 and FE-035..036 enforce static security invariants (100/100, e5fbb64), scripe audit --json fails closed on malformed JSON (01fa10b), .gitleaks.toml uses pure Go RE2 syntax (d1c5fdb), and rootless Dockerfile / .dockerignore preserve tracked appsettings.Production.json (cc11ad9e5, 268f169).

How Does the 4×9 Domain-Identity Assurance Flow Execute & What Governs External Production Cutover?

Every request is evaluated across 4 domain tiers (D1 Central Auth, D2 Tenant Subdomains, D3 Custom Domains, D4 Invalid/SQLi). It simultaneously enforces 9 identity tiers (I1 Protected Super Admin through I9 Suspended Accounts and Tenants).

Diagram structure
  • Browser / Playwright browser
  • Next.js Nonce Proxy proxy
  • Studio Preview Guard studio
  • .NET 10 API Ingress api
  • Tenant, DSR & SSRF Guard guard
  • browser → proxy · GET /login, /studio-preview, /dashboard-preview
  • proxy → browser · x-nonce CSP + DENY (SAMEORIGIN preview routes)
  • browser → studio · Dispatch cross-origin postMessage spoofing payload
  • studio → browser · Reject mismatched event.origin / event.source / schema
  • browser → api · Anonymous or cross-tenant POST / DSR / Webhook
  • api → guard · FallbackPolicy + IDsrSubjectOwnershipVerifier + FixedTimeEquals
  • guard → api · 401/403/400 + tenant-scoped CachingBehavior key
  • api → browser · Fail-closed response + Cache-Control: no-store

Release Readiness Verdict: Scoped GO vs. Conditional NO-GO for External Production Cutover

Code, branch merge, pre-production, and local UAT hold a Scoped GO (9953d551e Backend, d8ec386ad Frontend, 268f169 Dev-Tools, d1c5fdb root). Unconditional external production cutover remains a Conditional NO-GO until four live infrastructure gates pass. Gate 1 requires Vercel production redeploy (>= d8ec386ad) serving per-request x-nonce CSP and scripe-v3-static-only /sw.js. Gate 2 requires auth.scripe.org Cloudflare DNS CNAME and Vercel domain attachment (EnableCentralNativeAndPasskeyMigration=false, RpId=admin.scripe.org). Gate 3 requires Railway production deploy (>= 9953d551e) injecting ForwardedHeaders__ForwardLimit=2, ForwardedHeaders__KnownNetworks__0, GeoIp__OriginVerificationSecret, IdEncryption__AllowLegacyPlaintextStringFallback=false, Tenancy__VerificationPrefix=_scripe-verify, WebAuthn__RpId=admin.scripe.org, WebAuthn__UserVerification=required, and Authentication__CentralFederation__EnableCentralNativeAndPasskeyMigration=false. Gate 4 covers external IdP secrets outside git plus post-deploy smoke verification and carried Category 5 notes (V10.2.2, IdEncryptionService.cs:43 non-prod default retirement, OTP digits/TTL, and FieldProjectionMiddleware.FileGuard.cs:11-19 binary export FLS).
